method: The listed academic-search MCP namespace was unavailable. Used direct publisher, arXiv and author/institutional primary web pages. This is a bounded comparison, not an exhaustive priority review; metadata and technical-read scopes are stated per work.
copyright: Original paraphrases and links only; no third-party paper or source-code bytes copied.

works.title: A posteriori error estimation for the non-self-consistent Kohn–Sham equations
works.verified_scope: Publisher abstract and author preprint introduction: basis, iterative and floating-point errors for non-self-consistent pseudopotential plane-wave equations; silicon band-error-bar demonstration.
works.do_not_claim: This manuscript is not the first rigorous electronic-structure eigenvalue/error-bound method.

works.title: Practical Error Bounds for Properties in Plane-Wave Electronic Structure Calculations
works.verified_scope: Publisher metadata, abstract and preprint Schur/residual discussion. Covers computable estimates for density matrices, energy and forces; distinguishes rigorous and asymptotic/approximated estimators.
works.do_not_claim: Schur complement error corrections are new here, or every practical estimator in the prior paper is guaranteed.

works.title: Subspace Acceleration for Large-Scale Parameter-Dependent Hermitian Eigenproblems
works.venue: SIAM Journal on Matrix Analysis and Applications
works.verified_scope: Publisher metadata and author preprint abstract. Uses sampled eigenvectors and subspaces to construct rigorous bounds for parameter-dependent smallest eigenvalues.
works.do_not_claim: Subspace-accelerated parametric spectral certification is new here.

works.title: Certified model order reduction for parametric Hermitian eigenproblems
works.verified_scope: AMS publisher-indexed page confirms electronic publication date and DOI. arXiv v4 full text introduces fixed-N analytic Hermitian matrix families, certified eigenspace approximation and sufficient multiplicity recovery conditions.
works.access_note: Direct AMS DOI opening redirected to an inaccessible page; publisher text returned by web search and author-hosted arXiv full text were checked. No volume/page numbers inferred.
works.do_not_claim: Correct eigenspace dimension/multiplicity certification is unique to the present work.

works.title: A computer-assisted proof for photonic band gaps
works.verified_scope: Institutional full-text PDF, abstract and introduction. Two-dimensional polarized photonic problem, variational eigenvalue enclosures on a finite k grid and perturbation control between grid points to prove whole-zone gaps.
works.access_note: The supplied journal DOI 10.1007/s00033-008-8021-2 could not be opened. The public comparison cites the verified institutional version rather than asserting an unchecked journal record.
works.do_not_claim: Whole-Brillouin-zone strict band-gap proof is new here.

works.title: Verified Error Bounds for Matrix Decompositions
works.venue: SIAM Journal on Matrix Analysis and Applications
works.verified_scope: Publisher abstract and author publication list. Verification of existence and entrywise error bounds for common matrix decompositions, using tools including error-free-transformation dot products.
works.do_not_claim: Verified factorizations, LDL/Cholesky or accurate products themselves are original to this work.

works.title: Affine Arithmetic: Concepts and Applications
works.verified_scope: Publisher abstract and author publication list. Affine arithmetic retains first-order correlations to address standard interval dependency.
works.do_not_claim: Tracking shared input dependence is new here; the present carbon test evaluates a specific signed-channel bordered-form factor construction.

silicon_box_000.conclusion: stronger sufficient proof at fixed inputs; no universal speed claim

carbon_octant_000.conclusion: preserving factor dependence resolves the paired tests for these fixed inputs; negative sufficient estimates do not prove a physical closure
